as_read: No oral oregano oil or extract trial reaches rule 2: the stored study is uncontrolled, the only 500 mg capsule RCT is one post-exercise dose with no primary outcome named, and the essential oil RCT states no dose.

quote.text: The excretion of phenolic compounds was markedly increased in the higher phenolic group as compared to the placebo group, but no significant changes were observed in the safety parameters, serum lipids, or biomarkers of lipid peroxidation.

proposed_decision_text: The labels print oregano oil at 50 mg to 150 mg per serving (two rows print no amount), oregano extract at 500 mg and organic oregano leaf extract at 34 mg; one label carries an immune purpose. This is an abstracts-only review, and no study read meets the rule for credit. The stored study gave 600 mg emulsified oregano oil daily to 14 adults with enteric parasites and reports clearance, but has no control group (PMID 10815019). An essential oil trial in 106 people with metabolic syndrome reports an antibacterial effect, but the abstract does not describe randomization or a dose (PMID 33429991). A randomized trial in 34 athletes reports higher HDL cholesterol on two oregano essential oils over 14 days, but the abstract states no dose and no primary outcome (PMID 34496170). A randomized trial in 24 soldiers reports lower muscle damage markers after one 500 mg capsule, with no primary outcome named and a purpose these labels do not print (PMID 36615794). A four-week trial of juice enriched with oregano extract in 45 men found no significant change in serum lipids or lipid peroxidation, a food vehicle dosed as phenolics (PMID 16881679).
stored_rating_note: positive_moderate rests on one uncontrolled study of 14 adults (10815019); study type is stored correctly as uncontrolled, so the moderate rating looks too high.
unread_notes: Abstracts only. Read and not used: 33773189 (isolated carvacrol 1.2 mg/kg/day in asthma, not an ingredient these labels print), 37440992 (in vitro sperm), 21968667 (topical ointment). Marjoram tea trials (34455218, 41052623) are a different species and were not opened. 36903396 (savory, oregano and thyme mixture) not opened. No safety finding in the abstracts read.
